mechanism: Each CBar computes RatioBodyToCandleSize, RatioUpperShadowToCandleSize, RatioLowerShadowToCandleSize as body/shadow sizes *100/CandleSize (High-Low), stored as BAR_PROP_RATIO_* doubles. Zero-range candles return 100. These proportions become sortable bar features for pattern filters and as standalone candle-shape sensors.
data_needed: OHLC bars for symbol/timeframe; CandleSize=High-Low>0; library Bar.SetProperties from MqlRates.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any DoEasy timeseries symbol/period; demo charts in later tests; patterns searched on completed bars only
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a reusable per-bar body/wick geometry vector (not just OHLC) that can feed volatility-of-shape and rejection sensors across any TF.
quote: Using these proportions, we can always describe the general appearance of any candle, and using them you can also search for the right candles with the right proportions.

mechanism: CPatternControlPinBar::FindPattern filters one completed bar: body% ≤ criterion (default 30) and ≥ min_body_size; bullish if lower-shadow% ≥ larger-shadow criterion (default 60) and upper-shadow% ≤ smaller (default 30); bearish swaps shadows. Emits PATTERN_DIRECTION and stores actual ratios plus criteria on the pattern object; SERIES_EVENTS_PATTERN can fire on bar-1 discovery.
data_needed: Bar ratio properties; tunable body/larger/smaller shadow % criteria; unique control-object ID from packed criteria.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Price Action Pin Bar on any symbol/TF timeseries; one-candle formation; completed bars only
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes classic pin-bar rejection as a parameterized, eventable regime-change micro-sensor MIS can threshold and multi-instance with different ratio packs.
quote: The size of the candle body should be less than or equal to RatioBodyToCandleSizeValue() (default 30%) of the entire candle size… The lower shadow should be equal to or greater than RatioLargerShadowToCandleSizeValue() (default 60%).

mechanism: CheckInsideBar requires right bar fully inside left: High_right < High_left AND Low_right > Low_left. FindMotherBar walks leftward while consecutive pairs remain inside, anchoring the outermost mother; nested insides share one mother. Pattern is bidirectional; mother-bar open time stored so Bars(mother,defining) gives nested width. Bitmap frames the formation.
data_needed: Adjacent OHLC bars; mother-bar MqlRates; optional nested-formation bar count.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Price Action Inside Bar; two+ bars; any symbol/TF; nested chains supported
why_new_for_mis: Treats inside-bar nesting depth/width as a compression/liquidity-contraction sensor—MIS can track range coiling before breakouts.
quote: Return the fact that the bar on the right is completely within the dimensions of the bar on the left… such formations can go in a row, and then the mother bar will be one for all formations nested within each other.

mechanism: BAR_PROP_PATTERNS_TYPE holds OR-ed ENUM_PATTERN_TYPE bitflags (PATTERN_TYPE_NONE=0, others powers of two). Bar.AddPattern(type) sets bits; ListPatternsInVar / PatternsInVarDescription decode the ulong into a multi-label pattern list per bar for program filters.
data_needed: Detected pattern types written back to the defining bar; PATTERNS_TOTAL=26 enum space.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any bar in DoEasy timeseries; multiple PA/candle patterns co-located
why_new_for_mis: Enables MIS multi-label bar tagging—one bar can sense pin+inside+outside simultaneously without separate series scans.
quote: Since pattern types are bit flags, many different types of patterns can be stored in one variable. Then, from the value of this variable, we can always extract the type and, accordingly, the name of all patterns found on the bar.

mechanism: CheckOutsideBar requires opposite body types, candle-size ratio (absorbed/absorbing)*100 ≥ RatioCandleSizeValue, and right bar range/body engulfs left (High/Low and TopBody/BottomBody). Direction from signal close vs prior extreme: BUOVB close > prior High, BEOVB close < prior Low. PATTERN_PROP_RATIO_CANDLE_SIZES stores adjacent size ratio; entry described as break of signal High/Low ±5–10 points filter.
data_needed: Two adjacent bars with non-zero opposite bodies; min body size; candle-size % and body-to-candle % criteria via MqlParam.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Outside Bar / BUOVB / BEOVB Price Action; 2 candles; any symbol/TF
why_new_for_mis: Mirror of inside-bar compression: senses range expansion / engulfing volatility break with explicit size-ratio gates usable as a change sensor.
quote: BUOVB… The signal bar completely covers the previous one, its closing price is higher than the maximum of the previous bar… BEOVB… closing price is lower than the minimum of the previous bar.

mechanism: DailyProfitConstraint / CheckDailyProfitLimit snapshots dayStartEquity at D1 open, then gainPercent=((equity-start)/start)*100; when ≥ DailyProfitTarget (e.g. 2%) sets breached and TryOpenOrder blocks. DailyLossConstraint mirrors with (startBalance-equity)/startBalance vs MaxDailyLoss (e.g. 3%). Timer or OnTradeTransaction refreshes.
data_needed: ACCOUNT_EQUITY / ACCOUNT_BALANCE; iTime(_Symbol,PERIOD_D1,0) day anchor; target/loss percent inputs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Account-level (per-symbol instances in Part 1 demos); daily session; Forex live examples
why_new_for_mis: Frames account daily P&L% as a live risk-regime sensor MIS can fuse with market sensors to halt or de-risk when session PnL state flips.
quote: double gainPercent = ((currentEquity - dayStartEquity) / dayStartEquity) * 100.0; if(gainPercent >= DailyProfitTarget) { profitLimitReached = true;

mechanism: TradeFrequencyConstraint OnTradeTransaction counts DEAL_ENTRY_IN after HistoryDealSelect on TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD; resets on new D1; IsBreached when tradesToday>MaxTrades. Central TryOpenOrder / ConstraintManager.AnyBreached blocks sends. Optional magic/symbol scope noted.
data_needed: Deal history ENTRY_IN events; MaxTradesPerDay; day-start reset.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Per-symbol default in Part 1; account-wide later; daily
why_new_for_mis: Turns overtrading intensity into a countable behavioral sensor—MIS can treat elevated entry rate as a stress/regime flag independent of price.
quote: Trade activity is counted objectively through transaction events. When the number of trades reaches the limit, further orders are blocked.

mechanism: DailyTradeLimit.mqh CountTrades HistorySelect(dayStart,dayStart+86400) tallies all DEAL_ENTRY_IN account-wide; GetDayStart uses configurable HH:MM (not necessarily midnight); CalcState maps count→STATE_ALLOWED / STATE_CAUTION (remaining≤amber) / STATE_LIMIT. Dashboard colors + alerts; Enforcer cancels new pendings and closes post-limit DEAL_ENTRY_IN positions, leaving pre-limit positions.
data_needed: Terminal globals DTL_LIMIT, DTL_START_TIME (HHMM), DTL_AMBER; full account deal history; AutoTrading on.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Entire account any symbol; manual+EA entries; custom trading-day window; demo live tests
why_new_for_mis: Account-level entry-rate state (Allowed/Caution/Limit) is a portable risk-intensity sensor MIS can read without strategy coupling.
quote: The system counts confirmed DEAL_ENTRY_IN transactions per trading day using a configurable session start time. The scope covers the entire trading account, across all symbols, including manual trades and third-party Expert Advisors.

mechanism: OnTimer scans all PositionsTotal; CalculateRequiredSLDistance = (equity*risk%/100)/(tickValue*lot)*tickSize, floored by STOPS_LEVEL; flags Missing SL/TP or |currentSLDist-required|>0.5*point; AdjustLotSize partial-closes if lot exceeds maxSafeLot at minStop; EnforceSLTP sets SL/TP at open±required and ±required*R:R. Modes PASSIVE/ASSISTED/STRICT. Discipline score = corrections/checked.
data_needed: ACCOUNT_EQUITY; SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE/SIZE, STOPS_LEVEL, VOLUME_STEP; InpRiskPercent, InpRRatio; timer seconds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: All open positions any symbol; multi-symbol live chart tests; not TF-bound
why_new_for_mis: Converts intended equity-risk% and R:R into continuous account microstructure compliance sensors—MIS can detect exposure drift after entry.
quote: This function translates risk from a percentage of account equity into a price distance… The calculated Stop Loss distance is then compared to the actual distance between the entry price and the existing Stop Loss.

mechanism: CDisciplineEngine.IsTradeAllowed(symbol) ANDs SWL::IsSymbolAllowed, THN::IsAllowedNow (sessions + NewsEvents.csv pre/post blackout after Refresh), and DTL::IsTradingAllowed. Dashboard shows symbol/hours/daily/next session/next news and overall ALLOWED/BLOCKED; TradeEnforcer closes invalid new DEAL_ENTRY_IN and timer-scans open positions. Config externalized (TradingSessions.txt, NewsEvents.csv).
data_needed: Symbol whitelist; TradingSessions.txt; NewsEvents.csv with pre/post minutes; DailyTradeLimit params; engine Init.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5 dashboard demo; account-wide enforcer; news timestamps e.g. 2026.05.14 14:30
why_new_for_mis: Bundles calendar/session blackout sensing with symbol permission and daily intensity into one boolean trading-regime gate MIS can subscribe to.
quote: if(!SWL::IsSymbolAllowed(symbol)) return false; THN::Refresh(); if(!THN::IsAllowedNow()) return false; DTL::Refresh(); if(!DTL::IsTradingAllowed()) return false;

mechanism: Shows that a late-period D% drawdown at fixed 0.1 lot becomes ~10×D% under geometric lot∝balance (e.g. 5%→55%): loss dollars scale with X lots while deposit is X*$1K so percent drawdown ≈ (points_loss/1000)*100 independent of prior growth. Empirically RF collapses (10.73→0.51) on EURUSD H1 20_200 EA; sqrt(balance) MM is intermediate. Artificial P/L alternation can make fixed-lot rising equity fall under geometric MM when loss≥profit/(1+aggr*profit*pointval/10000).
data_needed: Balance curve under fixed 0.1 vs lot=k*Balance/1000 vs k*sqrt(Balance); max DD% and RF=NetProfit/MaxDD; EURUSD point value.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; EA 20_200 expert_v4.2_AntS 2000-06-07→2008-03-15; Lucky EA 2004-2008; Alpari-Demo
why_new_for_mis: Supplies a quantitative risk-sensing relation: fixed-lot DD% is a biased stability metric—MIS should evaluate strategies under the actual MM leverage path.
quote: If this drawdown results from the only one opened position… the X*0.1 lots trade… loss… which is equal to 100%*($550*X)/(X*$1K) = 55% of deposit before this drawdown.

mechanism: Models binary trade outcomes as Bernoulli(p); Feller return-time E≈1/(p q^r) implies max loss-cluster length grows ~log n. Script sequences_0_3 builds real cluster histograms vs 1000–65000 synthetic Bernoulli series; Zero-hypothesis (±2 SD, fuzzy bernoullity criterion) classifies TS as Bernoulli or dependent. Black-swan scan finds synthetic max loss clusters longer than report (e.g. 9 vs 5). Failure-drift / ultrashort n=40 series estimate ~34% time in shock/non-profit drawdowns for scalpers.
data_needed: Tester report binary P/L sequence; empirical p; average win/loss; synthetic Bernoulli generator; cluster-length histograms.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Lucky_ and Universum EAs on EURUSD H1 (and formed bars); 2004–2008 windows; scalping TP/SL configs
why_new_for_mis: Turns trade-result independence and loss-cluster tail risk into statistical sensors—MIS can flag strategies whose streak structure departs from Bernoulli or whose short-horizon failure drift is extreme.
quote: Consequence 1: … the longest loss cluster depending on the length of test series is unlimited in length, because it grows by law of logarithm!
